scenarios.name: Toggle the publication setting of an active copied view

scenario_steps.name: The MCAD Software has an empty part with a copied view active
Publish is checked in the copied view context menu
the user chooses Publish from the copied view context menu
Publish is unchecked when the context menu is reopened
the user chooses Publish from the copied view context menu again
Publish is checked when the context menu is reopened
